hypothesis: Anchoring the first draft action in the already-computed deep expert policy removes one avoidable rejection. Determine whether any acceptance gain survives complete cache retention, rollback and replacement inference in a continuous policy-only recurrence.
scope: The target is the expert policy for both players. Timed recurrence includes every packet dispatch, host maximal coupling, commit/rewind, replacement inference, transfers needed by the loop and final retained-cache completion. Prefill and compilation are excluded; symmetric native and full-reference audits are reported separately. Early terminal games are retained; different sampled traces need not have identical lengths. No MCTS equivalence, real completed-game throughput, hardware MFU, behavior-head learning or Go-strength claim.
